shortBio.en: Yardbirds blues prodigy who exits into Cream—and keeps teaching rock how to worship the solo.
shortBio.zh: Yardbirds 的 Blues 神童，出走进入 Cream——持续教摇滚如何崇拜独奏。

whyHub.en: Yardbirds → Cream: the guitar-hero pipeline that feeds Hard Rock mythology.
whyHub.zh: Yardbirds → Cream：喂养 Hard Rock 神话的吉他英雄管线。

body.en: Clapton's early exits are the plot. The Yardbirds are a lab; Cream is the explosion—three players arguing at stadium volume. Later careers sprawl; the chronicle cares about this hinge because Page inherits the same lab and builds Zeppelin next door.
body.zh: Clapton 早期的离开即剧情。Yardbirds 是实验室；Cream 是爆炸——三个人在体育馆音量下争吵。后来生涯很长；编年史在乎这个枢纽，因为 Page 继承同一间实验室，在隔壁盖起 Zeppelin。
